name: CrashLoopBackOff
root_cause: The inventory-config ConfigMap's LATENCY_MS was set to the non-numeric value 'abc'. inventory/main.py parses it with float() at import time, so every new inventory pod raises ValueError at startup and crash-loops.
observable_signals: A new inventory pod is in CrashLoopBackOff and its restart count keeps climbing
The previous container's logs (kubectl logs --previous) show a ValueError for the value 'abc'
The previous inventory pod is still serving; the rollout is stalled with an unavailable replica
accepted_remediations: Set LATENCY_MS in the inventory-config ConfigMap back to a numeric value, then restart deployment/inventory so the new value is read
ineffective_remediations: Roll back deployment/inventory to its previous revision: the bad value is in the ConfigMap, which is not part of a Deployment revision
Restart the inventory pod or Deployment without fixing the ConfigMap: the new pod reads the same bad value
Scale deployment/inventory up: every new replica reads the same bad value
Restart or redeploy other services (orders, gateway): they are healthy, and the old inventory pod is still serving
